verdict.rationale: Casium is a hosted immigration law firm and software platform. The only product surface in evidence is a vendor-run client portal at portal.casium.com. Nothing in the pack mentions self-hosting, on-premise deployment, downloadable software or source availability. Self-hosting is a fair question for a software platform, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
